title: Grade 7 Mathematics - Integers, Fractions, Decimals and Rational Numbers
description: A CBSE and CISCE-aligned Grade 7 Mathematics course covering Integers, Fractions, Decimals and Rational Numbers. It follows CBSE/NCERT middle-stage Mathematics and CISCE Upper Primary Mathematics with clear theory, visuals, solved examples and practice.
subject: Mathematics

chapters.name: Integers
learningObjectives: Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Integer addition
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Integer subtraction
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Integer multiplication and division
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Integer word problems

chapters.name: Fractions, Decimals and Rational Numbers
learningObjectives: Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Multiplication of fractions
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Division of fractions
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Decimal operations
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Representing rational numbers
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Comparing rational numbers

learningOutcomes: Explain the key CBSE and CISCE ideas in Integers, Fractions, Decimals and Rational Numbers
Use diagrams, tables, equations or graphs to model problems
Solve graded practice and board-style questions
Apply the concepts in real-life situations
tags: Integers, Fractions, Decimals and Rational Numbers
